### 1. The request, the simulator

Renata Quillen (Thornbury Survey & Engineering, PLLC) opens: "We'd like the four laptops we ordered to come set up and enrolled with Autopilot instead of plain, still on rush. If you can sort it out today I'll sign whatever needs signing." Target object: the four Dell Latitude 5450 on quote HQ-052418 (given on request). Timing: today. Action boundary: switch them to set-up/enrolled, keep rush; she signs what she is handed. Simulator is passive: identity on request (phone 9195550512 + PIN 538146), signs handed tools herself, accepts schedule charges, ends on "set-up laptop order is approved".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

- HQ-052418 = order f1a9b68c, `variant_name 'Standard Endpoint Order'`, `status 'ordered'`, `order_placed_date '2026-09-28'`, `ship_date ''` -> after the purchase order, not shipped. `cancellation_terms_by_order_type`: Standard Endpoint Order "Order may be cancelled at all after the purchase order | Yes". `order_cancellation_rules`: "Ordered, not shipped | Only where the order type allows cancellation after the purchase order".

- A Staged Endpoint quote for the same line already exists: order a7854dfb, HQ-052419, `Staged Endpoint Order`, `status 'quoted'`, same part `LAT5450-U5135U-16-512`, qty 4, unit_price 1209.6, rush True, quote_date 2026-09-24, quote_total 5393.4.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Cancellation fee of f1a9 (cancellation day 2026-10-07).**
Computation doc `standard_endpoint_cancellation_fee`: 10 percent of the quote total, rounded half up once. Factor docs found:
- `clearpath_tier_rates_for_endpoint_cancellations`: active ClearPath Professional -> **8.0 percent** (record: managed agreement `variant_name 'ClearPath Professional'`, `status 'active'`).
- `purchase_order_age_and_allocation_on_endpoint_cancellations`: PO 2026-09-28 -> 2026-10-07 = 9 days, "at least 7 days" -> fee percentage of quote total **plus 12.00 per unit** (record: `order_placed_date`).
- `clearpath_late_fees_and_endpoint_cancellation_admin_charge`: ClearPath late fees "posted ... fewer than twelve whole months before the day the cancellation is recorded": 2026-06-01 counts; 2025-10-01 is 12 whole months and 6 days before -> not fewer than twelve -> excluded; exactly 1 -> **25.00** (record: ClearPath billing `managed_late_fee`).
- `rush_cost_kept_on_endpoint_cancellations`: rush_requested True, approved 2026-09-28 (>= 1 day before) -> **75.00** kept (record: `rush_requested`, `approved_date`).
Fee = 0.08 x 4938.40 = 395.072 + 4 x 12.00 + 25.00 + 75.00 = 543.072 -> **543.07**.
Fall-back (computation doc only): 10 percent x 4938.40 = **493.84** (definite, different).

**(b) Staged re-quote total of a7854dfb (re-quote date 2026-10-07).**
Computation doc `staged_requote_price_build_up`: units x carried-over unit price + 95.00/unit imaging + 25.00 staged handling + 150.00 staged rush (cancelled order quoted with rush) + 15.00/unit security preparation, nothing deducted, rounded once. Factor docs:

- `clearpath_tenure_handling_on_staged_requotes`: go-live 2024-03-11 -> 2026-10-07 = 30 whole months (12..36) -> **15.00**.
- `clearpath_tier_rush_charges_on_staged_requotes`: rush on cancelled order; Professional -> **75.00**.
- `security_preparation_charges_for_staged_endpoints`: E5 subscription expired -> no E5 plan; Business Premium active -> **8.00/unit**.
- `cancellation_fee_credit_on_staged_requotes`: 0 days from cancellation to re-quote; a ClearPath late fee (2026-06-01) posted fewer than twelve whole months before -> clause (b): lesser of 543.07 and 4 x 25.00 = **100.00**, deducted.
Total = 4 x 1209.60 = 4838.40 + 220.00 + 15.00 + 75.00 + 32.00 - 100.00 = **5080.40**.
Fall-back: 4838.40 + 380.00 + 25.00 + 150.00 + 60.00 = **5453.40**.

**(c) Approval deposit of a7854dfb (approval 2026-10-07).**
Credit exposure (`hardware_credit_exposure_limit`): active ClearPath -> limit 50000.00; open exposure immediately before approval: f1a9 cancelled (adds nothing), 5485 closed -> 0 + 5080.40 within -> normal endpoint schedule. Computation doc `endpoint_approval_deposit_amount`: threshold 5000.00 (5080.40 >= -> required), 25 percent of the quote total, rounded once. Factor docs:
- `clearpath_tier_deposit_shares_for_endpoint_orders`: Professional -> **20.0 percent**.
- `late_payment_points_on_endpoint_deposits`: one ClearPath late fee fewer than twelve whole months before -> **+5.0 points**.
- `managed_spend_relief_on_endpoint_deposits`: 141.55 x 19 = 2689.45 >= 0.5 x 5080.40 = 2540.20 -> **-4.0 points**.
- `clearpath_relationship_deposit_build_for_endpoint_orders`: go-live 30 whole months before approval (< 36) -> service charges in full (5080.40 - 4838.40 = 242.00) plus the deposit percentage of quantity x unit price.
Percentage 20 + 5 - 4 = 21. Deposit = 242.00 + 0.21 x 4838.40 = 1258.064 -> **1258.06**.
Fall-back: 25 percent x 5080.40 = **1270.10** (definite, different).

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials

- **P_root: approve the staged quote a7854dfb** (customer's own write; hub `endpoint_order_quote_approval_and_deposit`). Its waiting sentence: "The deposit on a staged quote that takes over a plain endpoint line cancelled after its purchase order is not fixed until that staged quote carries a quote date no earlier than the cancellation date of the line it takes over." Records: a7854dfb quote_date 2026-09-24; the plain line f1a9 is not yet cancelled (the switch requires it to be, see P2). Searching "quote date ... re-dates" / "staged quote" finds the hub `staged_endpoint_requote_of_a_cancelled_line`: the revision "re-dates it to the revision day so a new validity period starts". -> P1. **state-derived**.
- **P1: revise the staged quote onto the cancelled line** (hub `staged_endpoint_requote_of_a_cancelled_line`). Waiting sentence: "A re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line is priced only after the order it re-quotes shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it." Records: f1a9 `status 'ordered'`, ledger has no cancellation fee. Searching "cancelled ... cancellation fee ... Standard Endpoint Order" finds `standard_endpoint_order_signed_cancellation`: one call "moves the order to cancelled ... and books the cancellation fee on the order's billing ledger as a new invoice". -> P2. **state-derived**.
- **P2: cancel f1a9 after its purchase order** (hub `standard_endpoint_order_signed_cancellation`; customer-signed). No waiting sentence beyond identity. Leaf.
- Order: P2 -> P1 -> P_root. No hop pre-solved: no hub names another problem's tool or route.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked" (approve HQ-052419 as it stands, at 5393.40): leaves the plain f1a9 order live — `multiple_orders_per_client`: "each becomes a separate order ... a figure on one order ... never transfers to another order", so the four plain laptops would still ship and the request was "instead of plain"; and once the line is taken over, the hub's waiting sentence keeps the deposit unfixed while the staged quote is dated 2026-09-24, before the cancellation date. Excluded.
- Cancel and approve without revising: blocked by the same waiting sentence (quote date 2026-09-24 < cancellation 2026-10-07). Excluded.
- Revise before cancelling: blocked by P1's waiting sentence. Excluded.
- Late fee of 2025-10-01: "fewer than twelve whole months" with the whole-month convention (12 complete on 2026-10-01) -> excluded; this boundary is closed by the documents ("eleven months ... counts; ... thirteen ... does not" plus the whole-month counting stated in the tenure docs).
- E5 plan: `security_preparation...` "a subscription in any other status gives it neither" -> expired E5 excluded.
- Factor findability: every factor above was found from record words — "ClearPath Professional"/"active" (managed agreement), "managed_late_fee" (ClearPath billing), "Microsoft 365 Business Premium"/"E5 ... expired" (licensing), `rush_requested`, `order_placed_date`, `approved_date`, seat_rate/seat_count — via KB_search on those words; none was reached through the computation documents, which do not mention variation.

Blind conclusion: unique solution as in items 4-5.
